notes.title: Update 8.2.2025 - Chain Lightning & Critical Strike Overhaul Update
notes.content:
[h2]🌟 New Upgrade: Chain Lightning[/h2]

I've added a brand-new upgrade for the Magic Wand—Chain Lightning! This upgrade unlocks at Magic Wand Mastery Level 2 and enhances crowd control capabilities while keeping things balanced.

Projectiles can now chain to up to 2 additional enemies.

Each chain deals 70% of the previous hit's damage.

Chains only occur within 120 unit range.

Features dynamic lightning visual effects and sound feedback.

[h2]⚖️ Balance Considerations[/h2]

This upgrade is designed to reward specialization in the Magic Wand while maintaining fair gameplay.

Chain Lightning is a mastery-gated upgrade, encouraging dedicated wand users.

Damage reduction per chain (70%) ensures it remains a strategic tool rather than an overpowered ability.

The limited range prevents it from clearing entire rooms effortlessly.
[h2]
🎨 Visual & Technical Enhancements[/h2]

The Chain Lightning effect was a blast to develop, and I paid extra attention to making it feel immersive.

New lightning chain effects dynamically connect targets.

Randomized arcs make each chain unique.

Particle effects and color theming match the Magic Wand’s aesthetic.

Smart target selection prevents infinite loops.

Auto-cleanup system ensures memory efficiency.
[h1]
🔄 Critical Strike System Overhaul[/h1]

I've completely reworked how critical strikes function! Instead of being tied to meta upgrades, they now scale with weapon mastery.

Critical strikes are now entirely mastery-based.

Each weapon’s crit potential grows as mastery level increases.

Dynamic, range-based crit chance system replaces fixed values.

Removed the "Critical Strike" meta upgrade.
[h2]
🎯 New Mastery-Based Critical Chance Ranges
[/h2]
Your crit chance now scales dynamically based on mastery level:

[b]APPRENTICE[/b]: Fixed 5% chance

[b]ADVANCED[/b]: Random 5-8% chance per hit

[b]EXPERT[/b]: Random 5-12% chance per hit

[b]MASTER[/b]: Random 5-15% chance per hit
[h2]
💥 Critical Damage Multipliers
[/h2]
To keep things fair but impactful, crit damage scales with mastery as well:

[b]APPRENTICE[/b]: 150% damage

[b]ADVANCED[/b]: 175% damage

[b]EXPERT[/b]: 200% damage

[b]MASTER[/b]: 200% damage (special effects planned!)

[h2]⚙️ How It Works
[/h2]
Instead of a fixed percentage, each hit now rolls for a critical strike within a dynamic range. This makes crits feel more unpredictable and rewarding while still encouraging progression.

Example: At MASTER level, a hit can have anywhere from 5-15% crit chance, keeping things exciting without being overpowered.

[h2]🛠️ Technical Implementation[/h2]

CriticalHandlerComponent manages crit logic within weapon scenes.

WeaponMasteryComponent ensures proper scaling.

Automatic registration & cleanup keeps things running smoothly.

Built-in statistics tracking for debugging and future improvements.

Debug logging to monitor performance.

[h2]🔮 Future Plans[/h2]

Special critical effects for mastery level weapons.

Enhanced visual feedback on crits.

Weapon-specific critical behaviors.

A UI panel for tracking crit stats.

This update brings major changes to both magic wands and critical strikes, adding depth and variety to combat. Let me know what you think—I’ll be fine-tuning everything based on feedback!

notes.title: 📜 Dev Update: Combat and Visual Improvements
notes.content:
🔄 Scythe Mastery Improvements:
• The scythe now intelligently targets enemies in any direction.
• Added line-of-sight checks so the scythe won't swing at enemies behind walls.
• Removed the rigid left/right only attacks - your scythe can now swing in a full 360-degree arc.
• Fixed issues where enemies above or below the player weren’t being targeted properly.

🎮 Gameplay Impact:
These changes make the scythe feel much more natural to use. It will now automatically target the closest visible enemy, making combat more dynamic and letting you focus on positioning and timing rather than worrying about orientation.

🔧 Technical Details:
For the curious minds out there, I've implemented a raycast system for better target detection and completely reworked how the scythe orients itself during attacks. This means better performance and more precise hit detection.

🎨 UI and Visual Updates:
I’ve also redesigned the UI elements of the main menu and cards to better align with the game’s theme. The updated visuals now feel darker and more in tune with the name and atmosphere of the game, shedding the previously cartoonish style. Expect a more immersive and cohesive experience from the moment you launch the game.

💭 Looking Forward:
I'm continuing to refine combat mechanics across all weapons and enhance the visual presentation of the game. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping me identify areas for improvement.

🐛 Known Issues:
None currently identified - please report if you find any!

Happy hunting! 🗡️

notes.title: Update 18.1.2025
notes.content:
[b]✨ New Weapon Added: Magic Wand ✨[/b]

    Automatically targets the nearest enemy with magical projectiles.
    Features stunning arcane particle effects with magical trails and impact bursts.
    Stats:
        Base Damage: 5
        Range: 200 units
        Fire Rate: Every 0.5 seconds

    Available in the standard upgrade pool.
[b]
🔨 Anvil Weapon Mastery Update:[/b]

    New Mastery Reward: Unholy Momentum
        Unlockable at Expert Mastery level, granting the ability to reduce the anvil drop cooldown.
        Cooldown reduction per upgrade level: 15% (max of 3 levels).
        Minimum cooldown limit: 50% of base time.
    
   Technical Improvements:
        Balanced cooldown reduction scaling.
        Added mastery level requirement checks.
        Optimized timer handling for smoother gameplay.

[b]🧟 Enemy Rebalance & Progression Changes 🧟‍♀️[/b]

    Time-Based Enemy Progression:
        0–2 minutes: Basic enemies to help you ease into the action.
        2 minutes: Wizard enemies join the battlefield.
        4 minutes: Bat enemies swoop into the arena.
        6 minutes: Brace yourself for Demon enemies!
    
  Elite Enemy Adjustments:
        Reduced base elite spawn chance to make them feel more impactful.
        Elite spawn chance now scales more gradually with difficulty.
        Rebalanced maximum spawn chances for a fair but challenging experience.

[b]⚖️ General Balance Changes:[/b]

    Smoothed out the overall difficulty curve for better pacing.
    Adjusted enemy spawn rate acceleration to avoid overwhelming waves.
    Gradually increased enemy variety throughout each run.
    Fine-tuned spawn counts for a more balanced and enjoyable gameplay experience.

These updates are designed to enrich your gameplay experience with exciting new content, more balanced progression, and rewarding challenges. I’m looking forward to hearing your feedback—jump in and let me know what you think!
